processing: Each source decoded to 16-bit WAV, downmixed to mono and linearly resampled to 44100 Hz (fs725403, fs719244, fs674742, fs104407 and fs142892 are 44.1 kHz already).
Transient cuts ('hitS' > 0) are re-aligned so the first sample at >= 35% of the window peak sits 2 ms after the cut start.
Filters run with 30 ms of real source context before the cut: 2x RBJ high-pass at highpassHz (12 dB/oct each), optional RBJ low-pass at lowpassHz.
Raised-cosine fade-in/out (fadeInS/fadeOutS), peak-normalised to 0.89 (normaliseGainDb), packed with 20 ms of silence between cuts.

Runtime (ak47AudioDsp.ts buildAk47MagSeat): the hero seat is seatClickA+seatChunkA or seatClickB+seatChunkB (2-variant round robin), with the chunk given an extra 40 ms exponential decay, plus synthesized layers: thump 260->170 Hz (12 ms sweep, tau 18 ms, 0.7x, +1.5 ms), band-passed noise knock 380 Hz Q1.2 (tau 11 ms, 0.55x) and a faint steel ring 2369/991/6029 Hz (tau 45 ms, 0.18x); normalised to 0.89.
Runtime: dropSwish is fully synthesized (band-passed noise swell, no impact). If this file fails to load, every event is synthesized instead.
rebuild: Scratch builder build_sprite.mjs (session scratchpad rebuild/audio/). The cut table above is complete: re-running those windows, filters, fades and normalisation on the listed downloads reproduces this file; AK47_RELOAD_FOLEY_LAYOUT must then be updated from the new layout values.
